symptom: On a Mendix 11.16.0 project `mxcli check script.mdl -p app.mpr --references` printed "Check passed!" for `create or modify message definition collection …`; `mxcli exec` then failed with "create message definition collection: Mendix 11.15 removed message definition collections (project is 11.16.0) — each definition is its own document now" (also alter/drop/describe … collection)
cause: #1434 moved every version FLOOR into statementVersionGates so check -p sees it, but the collection refusal is a CEILING (Mendix 11.15 removed the type) and stayed inline in four handlers as `if projectStoresMessageDocuments(ctx) { return messageCollectionsRemovedError(…) }` — not a checkFeature call, so TestCheckFeatureIsOnlyCalledFromTheGateTable could not flag it
file: `mdl/executor/version_gates.go` (removedStatementError, called first by checkVersionGates); `mdl/executor/cmd_messagedefinitions.go` create/alter/drop handlers now call checkVersionGates
insight: The #1434 guard only detects gates spelled checkFeature(…); a refusal built from a version predicate plus a custom error is the same check/exec gap in a form the guard cannot see. When check passes what exec refuses for the version, grep the handler for ProjectVersion/IsAtLeast/projectStores*-style predicates, not only checkFeature. Removal belongs in the gate pass too, with exec's own error text so the two are byte-identical. Exec now refuses before writing the statements ahead of it (pre-flight), where it used to write them and fail part-way.
